Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (

             from authz.permissions pm

      then false
    else exists (

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then

  end;

    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code

  end;

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (

             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 3.083 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.

          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    else false
  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 3.436 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

Query Text: 
  select case
    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id

                          join public.hospitals h on h.id = c.hospital_id
                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then
      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id from public.hospitals h where h.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then
      p_requested_id = (select c.hospital_id from public.commissions c where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    else false
  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 3.699 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

      and m.role = p_role

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

    when p_resolution_kind = 'hospital' and p_assignment_kind = 'commission' then

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.

          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code

      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (

             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 4.478 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end

   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

    when p_assignment_kind = p_resolution_kind then
      p_assignment_id = p_requested_id

      p_requested_id = (select h.organization_id

                         where c.id = p_assignment_id)

    when p_resolution_kind = 'organization' and p_assignment_kind = 'hospital' then

    else false
  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 2.967 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- of defense.

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  end;

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 3.097 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

      and m.role = p_role

      and case p_scope_type

  -- of defense.
  and (p_user_id is distinct from auth.uid() or p_role is not distinct from app.active_role());

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  -- of defense.

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())

    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard

  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.
  select p_uid is not null and (
    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)
    or app.is_org_admin_of(p_org)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m

     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

  end;

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to

         rp.permission_code,

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (

             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)

       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

  select case

Query Text: 
  -- ORG AUTHORITY ONLY since AE4.7c. The commission staff_admin ascent moved to
  -- app.can_create_professional (row 43) — a staff_admin ADDS a professional, never modifies
  -- or redacts one (matrix § 12.8.5).
  --
  -- The `is_org_admin_of(p_org)` disjunct reads the CALLER's auth.uid(), not the `p_uid`
  -- target parameter, and so does `is_admin()`. With the ascent gone, `p_uid` is a null guard
  -- and nothing else: FUP-CAN-MANAGE-PROFESSIONAL-SELF-CHECK-ARM, narrowed rather than fixed.
  -- Left alone deliberately — changing it would move an answer, and this migration's claim is
  -- that only the staff_admin arm moves.

    coalesce(app.is_admin(), false)

  );

Query Text: 
  select m.role,
         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id
           when 'hospital'     then m.hospital_id
           when 'organization' then m.organization_id
         end
    from public.memberships m
   where app.is_active(p_principal)
     and m.principal_id = p_principal
     and (m.expires_at is null or m.expires_at > now())
     and m.scope_kind is not null

  union all

  select 'platform_admin', 'none', null::uuid
    from public.profiles p
   where p.id = p_principal
     and p.is_admin
     and app.is_active(p_principal);

psql:<stdin>:623: LOG:  duration: 3.094 ms  plan:
Query Text: 
  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).
         -- Neither uniform choice is correct.
         (p_principal is distinct from (select auth.uid())
          or af.role_code is not distinct from app.active_role())
    from authz.assignment_facts(p_principal) af
    join authz.roles r
      on r.code = af.role_code
    join authz.role_permissions rp
      on rp.role_code = af.role_code
    join authz.permission_implication_closure cl
      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

  select af.role_code,
         rp.permission_code,
         r.state::text,
         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
         -- hat (the 27 `_for` sites), a SELF question requires it (the 151 self-check sites).

      on cl.implying = rp.permission_code
     and cl.implied  = p_permission_code
   where authz.scope_reaches(af.scope_kind, af.scope_id, p_resolution_kind, p_scope_id);

Query Text: 
  select case
    -- (1) SCOPE-KIND VALIDATION, fail closed. `is distinct from` makes BOTH an unknown code
    -- (the subselect is NULL) and a NULL p_scope_kind deny, without a separate branch.
    when p_scope_kind is distinct from (
           select pm.resolution_scope_kind::text
             from authz.permissions pm
            where pm.code = p_permission_code)
      then false
    else exists (
      select 1
        from authz.entailed_grants(p_principal, p_scope_kind, p_scope_id, p_permission_code) eg
       where eg.role_state = 'authoritative'   -- (2) THE STATE GATE. Runtime sees ONLY this.
         and eg.hat_ok
    )
  end;

Query Text: 
  -- LAYER 3 (ADR 0176 D2). The permission code is a STRING LITERAL so the enforcement site is
  -- statically greppable (D7), and it is the ONLY place `commission.forms.edit` appears in the
  -- catalog. There are no hard-deny classes on form editing, so the two arms are a plain
  -- disjunction and their ORDER carries no semantics (Postgres does not guarantee OR evaluation
  -- order in any case).
  select p_uid is not null and (
    -- RE-KEYED ARM — was `app.is_staff_admin_of(p_commission_id)` in all four policies.
    authz.has_permission(p_uid, 'commission', p_commission_id, 'commission.forms.edit')
    -- PRESERVED ARM — the tenancy admins (org_admin / hospital_admin), both `legacy` roles whose
    -- catalog grants are inert. This is the legacy-equivalence half; deleting it is the
    -- regression this migration exists to avoid. `_for` rather than the bare wrapper because
    -- layer 3 is given its principal explicitly; at every call site p_uid IS auth.uid(), so the
    -- two are the same answer (`is_tenancy_admin_of(x)` is literally
    -- `is_tenancy_admin_of_for(x, (select auth.uid()))`).
    or app.is_tenancy_admin_of_for(p_commission_id, p_uid)
  );

         m.scope_kind::text,
         case m.scope_kind
           when 'commission'   then m.commission_id

         -- The §6A ASYMMETRY, carried verbatim from AE4.4b: a THIRD-PARTY question ignores the
